styles.name: Flat
styles.text: Check plain ink against every actual solid/state plate; flat does not imply high contrast.
styles.non_text: A low-difference plate may need a solid mark or boundary; text-identified controls can retain decorative faint edges.
styles.focus_scene: Independent focus against page and selected fill; test same-color plate/ground and all active states.
styles.transparency: Already opaque recipes unchanged; any optional alpha plate becomes its opaque semantic counterpart.
styles.contrast: Use qualified ink/required cues, suppress decorative color variation.
styles.forced_colors: System fills, marks and focus; do not assume absence of shadows already makes every mark safe.
styles.motion: No intrinsic material animation; stop added transitions that express decorative travel.

styles.name: Material / paper
styles.text: Evaluate paper tint plus any texture and folded/raised highlight beneath letters; reserve a calm reading plane.
styles.non_text: Paper elevation shadow is not an identifying field or selected-state mark.
styles.focus_scene: Test focus crossing paper edge, adjoining page and fold shadow; include paper on a nearly matching page.
styles.transparency: Keep opaque sheet; remove transmitted underlay if a mixed recipe adds one.
styles.contrast: Plain sheet and qualified boundaries; remove grain/fold contrast behind reading.
styles.forced_colors: System sheet and real required edges; shadow disappearance must not erase grouping or state.
styles.motion: Static sheet; stop fold/lighting/parallax effects if supplied.

styles.name: Transparency
styles.text: Compose both background and alpha ink over the full backdrop domain; test the interior-luminance collision.
styles.non_text: A translucent rim or fill needs evaluation against its actual neighbor, not its nominal source color.
styles.focus_scene: Use qualified opaque focus/backing; test moving and nested backdrops on both sides of the indicator.
styles.transparency: Opaque semantic body; never whole-element opacity.
styles.contrast: Opaque calm ground and solid required marks.
styles.forced_colors: System body/ink/outline; no alpha-only state differentiation.
styles.motion: Stop animated opacity; retaining static alpha still requires the transparency contrast proof.

styles.name: Glassmorphism
styles.text: Blurred scene plus tint is the ground; uniform matching patches survive blur. Put dense content on an opaque well.
styles.non_text: Transparent glass perimeter cannot alone guarantee identification over arbitrary scenes.
styles.focus_scene: Focus independent of bright rim; adversarial scrolling image edges and another glass panel behind it.
styles.transparency: Opaque panel, no backdrop filter; retaining clear fill after removing blur is not the fallback.
styles.contrast: Solid reading surface, required edge and no competing reflection.
styles.forced_colors: System panel and real boundary/focus; remove optical pseudo-elements and image textures.
styles.motion: Stop backdrop parallax/light tracking; static glass still needs its contrast domain.

styles.name: Acrylic (Fluent)
styles.text: Evaluate tint, blur and noise together; native fallback behavior is not inherited by a CSS imitation.
styles.non_text: Noise or frosting cannot replace a required control/selection cue.
styles.focus_scene: Test focus beside noise and a high-frequency scene; verify fallback when blur is unavailable.
styles.transparency: Opaque semantic fallback and remove scene acquisition/noise over reading.
styles.contrast: Calm opaque body and strong required marks; disable noisy/scattered decoration.
styles.forced_colors: System solid body and edges; no blanket forced-color opt-out.
styles.motion: Stop noise evolution and illumination tracking; keep controls responsive.

styles.name: Mica
styles.text: An opaque foundation reduces local backdrop uncertainty, but tint/texture and any adaptation still need ink checks.
styles.non_text: Persistent surface identity is distinct from the required mark of its controls.
styles.focus_scene: Test focus on tinted foundation and child overlays; include every allowed wallpaper-derived tint if implemented.
styles.transparency: Use stable opaque semantic foundation; no wallpaper sampling dependency.
styles.contrast: Plain foundation, qualified required cues; do not lift near-black page merely to simulate depth.
styles.forced_colors: User system ground/content colors, real required marks.
styles.motion: Freeze optional environment/tint transitions; no automatic parallax.

styles.name: Liquid Glass (Apple, 2025)
styles.text: Refraction can move a hostile source patch under text; native adaptive ink behavior cannot be assumed or copied as hover recoloring.
styles.non_text: Dynamic lens/rim is supplementary; preserve solid semantic mark or qualified boundary.
styles.focus_scene: Test focus under maximum supported displacement and elastic states; separate ring from lens clip.
styles.transparency: Opaque no-lens shell with readable contents; native frosted behavior is not a numeric web preset.
styles.contrast: Plain opaque reading ground and solid cue, suppress lens/specular competition.
styles.forced_colors: System surface/marks, disable SVG displacement/backdrop optics explicitly.
styles.motion: Stop elastic deformation, refraction motion and tracking; immediate state feedback remains.

styles.name: Neumorphism
styles.text: Labels require their own ink contrast, independent of pale relief.
styles.non_text: Same-color body and weak lobes can fail when they alone identify field/track/state; source-palette bounds are in method.md.
styles.focus_scene: Use a real focus indicator distinct from permanent raised/pressed shading; test flattened shadows and selected+focus.
styles.transparency: Keep opaque body; reduction does not fix weak relief boundaries on its own.
styles.contrast: Add qualified actual boundary/mark and simplify relief, retaining readable labels.
styles.forced_colors: Real system border/selection/focus replaces vanished shadows.
styles.motion: Stop animated lighting/extrusion; preserve explicit persistent state rather than shadow direction alone.

styles.name: Claymorphism
styles.text: Broad bright/dark modeling can cross label strokes; keep a plain central reading ground.
styles.non_text: Soft extrusion may look raised without supplying a required distinct shape.
styles.focus_scene: Focus outside clay lobes and clips; test low-boundary pastel body and dark-mode profile.
styles.transparency: Opaque body; remove any translucent jelly coating in a combined recipe.
styles.contrast: Simplify bevel/lobes, use solid required cue and readable center.
styles.forced_colors: System body with real edge/mark; no shadow-dependent silhouette.
styles.motion: Stop squash/bounce/light travel; shape and hit area remain stable.

styles.name: Skeuomorphism
styles.text: Physical textures/engraved text require actual local paint checks, not assumed real-world readability.
styles.non_text: A familiar object metaphor does not qualify weak state/track cues.
styles.focus_scene: Focus must be visible independently of texture/engraving; test every functional region and asset failure.
styles.transparency: Opaque reading/control grounds; remove transmitted glass portions while retaining meaning.
styles.contrast: Simplify texture and modeling; preserve label, required shape and state.
styles.forced_colors: Replace decorative material images with system paint; meaningful content images retain alternatives.
styles.motion: Stop decorative mechanical motion/parallax; retain immediate functional state and announcements.

styles.name: Aqua
styles.text: Gloss bands and saturated body gradients can reverse local contrast; inspect the whole label footprint.
styles.non_text: Bright rim is not a reliable selected/pressed cue; retain explicit semantic core.
styles.focus_scene: Focus separate from glossy halo; test the highlight crossing text and selected fill.
styles.transparency: Opaque body; remove watery/transmitted layers in combined recipes.
styles.contrast: Flat qualified body/label and solid required marks; remove gloss band.
styles.forced_colors: System controls/marks, no gradient/shadow-only distinctions.
styles.motion: Stop moving highlights, watery deformation and throbbing emphasis.

styles.name: Frutiger Aero
styles.text: Scenic imagery plus glossy overlays increases background variation; give UI reading an opaque ground.
styles.non_text: Decorative landscape/glass depth cannot supply control or chart semantics.
styles.focus_scene: Test focus over scenery and gloss, cropped backgrounds and image-load failure.
styles.transparency: Opaque widgets/reading regions; keep scenery outside those receivers if appropriate.
styles.contrast: Calm required UI; remove scenic/gradient competition under text.
styles.forced_colors: System UI; hide decorative scenery but retain meaningful media and alternatives.
styles.motion: Stop drifting scenes, animated highlights and parallax.

styles.name: Glow / neon
styles.text: Keep an opaque readable ink core; halo brightness is not the letter color.
styles.non_text: Opaque status/graphic core must remain identifiable when glow is removed.
styles.focus_scene: Focus cannot be another indistinguishable bloom; test dense neighboring glows and brightest allowed halo.
styles.transparency: Make any tinted translucent housing opaque; halo is emission, not backdrop transmission.
styles.contrast: Suppress decorative bloom, retain qualified core and separate focus.
styles.forced_colors: System core/real marks; no shadows as sole status or focus.
styles.motion: Stop pulsing/flicker and traveling light; retain static truthful status.

styles.name: Gradient fill — linear
styles.text: Search all interpolated positions beneath ink, not just stops; include alpha and declared interpolation space.
styles.non_text: Required fill/mark checks follow the weakest meaningful region, not average hue.
styles.focus_scene: Independent solid focus; test angle changes and a narrow matching-luminance band crossing text.
styles.transparency: Opaque backing or opaque validated gradient; remove transmission without discarding functional color data.
styles.contrast: Plain semantic reading ground; simplify decorative gradient if it competes.
styles.forced_colors: Replace decorative gradient with system paint; preserve information using marks/labels.
styles.motion: Stop stop-position/color cycling and background-position travel.

styles.name: Gradient fill — radial
styles.text: Inspect center, rings and off-center glyph positions at each supported size.
styles.non_text: A bright center/dim edge may leave required extent unclear; retain solid cue.
styles.focus_scene: Focus outside bloom; test center/radius changes and edge hotspots.
styles.transparency: Opaque backing; keep only a qualified nontransmitting field.
styles.contrast: Remove decorative hotspot under content; retain semantic fill/mark.
styles.forced_colors: System paint/required shape replaces decorative gradient.
styles.motion: Stop breathing radius and moving center; retain static meaning.

styles.name: Gradient fill — conic
styles.text: Inspect wedge interiors and seam beneath text at all allowed angles; stop endpoints are insufficient.
styles.non_text: For meaningful wedges/rings, preserve adjoining-part identification and labels separately from decoration.
styles.focus_scene: Independent focus; test seam and similar-luminance adjacent wedges.
styles.transparency: Opaque ground; preserve functional chart information with qualified cues.
styles.contrast: Simplify decorative sweep; add required outline/labels where sectors need distinction.
styles.forced_colors: System markers/labels or equivalent accessible graphic; do not erase quantitative content.
styles.motion: Stop decorative rotation; keep progress value truthful and static.

styles.name: Gradient fill — mesh
styles.text: Interior extrema need full-field/renderer evidence; control-point colors alone do not bound the text ground.
styles.non_text: Complex patches may hide required shape; use independent solid cue.
styles.focus_scene: Focus on qualified backing; test interior patches, crops and supported deformation extremes.
styles.transparency: Opaque reading plane; no arbitrary scene through mesh alpha.
styles.contrast: Plain body beneath UI; retain mesh only in nonessential decoration.
styles.forced_colors: System UI; suppress decorative mesh assets explicitly if URL-based.
styles.motion: Stop mesh drift and point animation.

styles.name: Gradient stroke
styles.text: Text is checked against body, including any rim/gloss crossing its footprint.
styles.non_text: A fading or hue-varying contour cannot be assumed sufficient; provide solid required edge separate from decorative stroke.
styles.focus_scene: Focus uses independent solid paint; test transparent rim segment, corner and narrow size.
styles.transparency: Opaque reading body; decorative stroke alpha is not itself a transparent pane.
styles.contrast: Replace required fading contour with solid cue; decorative rim can be removed.
styles.forced_colors: Real system border/outline, not a gradient mask.
styles.motion: Stop rotating/chasing stroke; keyboard focus remains steady.

styles.name: Inner shadow
styles.text: Inset shading changes the ground behind edge-near text; test its maximum supported extent.
styles.non_text: An inset primitive may actually implement a fill/marker; classify intent before disabling it.
styles.focus_scene: Focus distinct from inset groove; test small fields where shading reaches values.
styles.transparency: Opaque well; keep only qualified local shading if allowed.
styles.contrast: Remove decorative cavity, preserve real required boundary and functional marker.
styles.forced_colors: Replace shadow-implemented marks with actual system shapes/rails before removing decoration.
styles.motion: Stop moving/changing cavity; value/state paint stays stable.

styles.name: Inner glow
styles.text: Bright interior emission can wash out ink; test glow encroaching on the label.
styles.non_text: Preserve opaque boundary/core; faint interior glow is supplementary.
styles.focus_scene: Focus distinct from permanently luminous inset; test combined invalid/selected states.
styles.transparency: Opaque body; no change required for emission alone if local contrast is proven.
styles.contrast: Suppress inset bloom and keep qualified body/core.
styles.forced_colors: System required marks; no shadow-based glow dependence.
styles.motion: Stop breathing/flickering emission; keep static signal.

styles.name: Outer glow
styles.text: Test neighboring text too: an outer halo may change its background.
styles.non_text: Halo cannot expand a quantitative fill or stand in for an opaque status mark.
styles.focus_scene: Separate solid focus from existing glow; test overlapping neighbors and clips.
styles.transparency: Opaque hosting surface when needed; glow remains a separate channel.
styles.contrast: Remove bloom, retain semantic emitter and focus.
styles.forced_colors: System mark/focus; remove optional shadow/filter emission.
styles.motion: Stop pulses and traveling bloom; preserve a stable emitter.

styles.name: Drop shadow
styles.text: Inspect text on the shadow receiver as well as inside the casting object.
styles.non_text: Cast is optional depth unless explicitly the sole cue; required control/state information must survive its removal.
styles.focus_scene: Focus not part of cast list; test clipping, stacked shadows and Flat Surface.
styles.transparency: Use opaque body if combined with transmission; cast itself is not body transparency.
styles.contrast: Simplify cast, preserve required edge/mark and receiver readability.
styles.forced_colors: Real system edge if needed after shadow loss.
styles.motion: Stop floating/lift animation; retain established Surface eligibility.

styles.name: Bevel / emboss
styles.text: Lit/shaded facets under content may approach its luminance; keep ordinary UI ink plain.
styles.non_text: Relief direction alone must not carry required selected/pressed state.
styles.focus_scene: Solid separate focus; test light-angle changes and the darkest/lightest facet.
styles.transparency: Opaque body; optional facet modeling still needs local checks.
styles.contrast: Flatten modeling where necessary; retain actual required shape/mark.
styles.forced_colors: System body/edge/state instead of vanished bevel shadows/gradients.
styles.motion: Stop light-angle/facet animation; persistent state remains explicit.

styles.name: Letterpress
styles.text: Evaluate actual ink core against local ground; thin highlight/shadow is not a blanket contrast rescue.
styles.non_text: A glyph used as an icon has non-text duties; debossed decoration cannot replace its solid meaningful core.
styles.focus_scene: Focus belongs to the interactive control, not its engraved label; test smallest allowed inscription.
styles.transparency: Opaque qualified ground; keep body and content alpha separate.
styles.contrast: Plain readable text; ordinary UI already disallows this decoration under task 05.
styles.forced_colors: System ink, no text-shadow dependency.
styles.motion: Stop shifting engraving/light effects; readable characters persist.

styles.name: Grain
styles.text: Noise extrema, scale and placement matter beneath letters; a mean gray or average image is insufficient.
styles.non_text: Texture must not hide thin required marks or imply false states.
styles.focus_scene: Focus has a quiet backing; test maximum supported grain strength and worst seed/phase.
styles.transparency: Opaque body; remove texture over reading if it still impairs contrast.
styles.contrast: Disable decorative noise on UI reading/required cues.
styles.forced_colors: Explicitly disable decorative URL/SVG noise; system marks remain.
styles.motion: Freeze/remove animated noise; choose a qualified static fallback rather than an arbitrary frame.
